hotel.name: Harborview Grand Hotel
hotel.cancellationPolicy: Free cancellation up to 48 hours before check-in. Cancellations within 48 hours are charged one night's rate.
hotel.breakfast: A complimentary continental breakfast is included with every room, served 7:00 AM–10:30 AM in the Harbor Room.

amenities.name: Swimming Pool
amenities.details: Outdoor heated pool, open 7:00 AM–9:00 PM, located on the 2nd floor terrace.

amenities.name: Free WiFi
amenities.details: Complimentary high-speed WiFi throughout the hotel.

amenities.name: Spa
amenities.details: Full-service spa, open 9:00 AM–7:00 PM, reservations recommended.

amenities.name: Pet Policy
amenities.details: Pets under 25lbs allowed for a $50/stay fee.

rooms.name: Standard Queen
rooms.description: Cozy room with one queen bed, city view, 300 sq ft.

rooms.name: Deluxe King
rooms.description: Spacious room with one king bed, harbor view, 400 sq ft.

rooms.name: Family Suite
rooms.description: Two-room suite with one king bed and a pull-out sofa, sleeps up to 4, 650 sq ft.

rooms.name: Triple Room
rooms.description: One queen bed plus a twin bed, ideal for 3 guests, 450 sq ft.

faqs.question: Is smoking allowed?
faqs.answer: The hotel is entirely non-smoking. Designated outdoor smoking areas are available at the main entrance.

faqs.question: Is there an airport shuttle?
faqs.answer: Yes, a complimentary shuttle runs to and from the airport every 30 minutes, 5:00 AM–11:00 PM.

faqs.question: What is the minimum check-in age?
faqs.answer: Guests must be at least 18 years old to check in without a parent or guardian.
